target: Sequoia Capital Fund (new vintage, unspecified name)
description: Sequoia Capital's newest fund vintage, raised under incoming co-stewards per the firm's Nov 4, 2026 memo 'The Sequoia of Tomorrow.' The firm says it has raised roughly $10B in new funds while closing its London office and ending the Arc and Scouts programs — no public breakdown by strategy or AI-specific earmark has been given.

Power-infrastructure financing facility of up to SAR1.4bn (~$373.3M) extended to PIF-owned AI company HUMAIN by Infra (Saudi Arabia's National Infrastructure Fund), signed 8 Nov 2026 in Riyadh. Funds substations, transmission and grid connections for HUMAIN's AI data centers, forward-provisioning grid capacity toward a stated 1GW target well ahead of near-term compute (a companion GPU-procurement facility, ~$293.3M, was signed the same day).
